primary_goal: make component-preset compatibility inputs round-trip canonically without silently discarding conflicting user-visible fields
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

scope.phase: alias normalization, ignored derived fields, metadata extensions, and pre-save validation
scope.trigger: preset_id/component_spec aliases, full detail PUT, conflicting read-only derived values, reserved metadata shape, or analysis sources without external URLs

problem_domain_closure.aliases: single aliases canonicalize; type-sensitive conflicts reject
problem_domain_closure.detail_roundtrip: GET detail -> PUT -> reload preserves editable fields and metadata
problem_domain_closure.ignored_derived_fields: matching values accepted; conflicts reject; changed component is authoritative and stale summaries recompute
problem_domain_closure.metadata_extensions: unknown keys retained; reserved shapes and keys validated before save
problem_domain_closure.source_contract: all built-in details round-trip, including A_ANALYTICAL source with empty URL
problem_domain_closure.atomicity: invalid direct mutation does not create or modify presets.json
problem_domain_closure.api: existing client and persistence error contracts remain unchanged

data_roles.comparison: parent behavior and persisted canonical keys
data_roles.holdout: HTTP full-detail PUT, all 10 built-in component details, analysis source, stale summary with changed component

guardrails: component is authoritative when explicitly changed and stale derived summaries are recomputed
do not close metadata extension keys into an arbitrary vocabulary
do not reject valid A_ANALYTICAL sources solely for missing external URL
preserve H13/H14 persistence and error-envelope contracts
run clean .venv full suite before promotion
next_step: review whether compatibility aliases/ignored fields need an explicit persisted schema version or migration audit
